GHL reports a null duration on some completed calls, so talk time is a floor, not an exact total.

These GHL users are dialing from the CRM but are not on the active SDR roster, so their calls count in the floor totals but not in a setter row: Mary Lim (378 dials), HNYZbzBXUZ6aAMewDmH3 (316 dials), pzeMaTtiI7vnhomwOwYW (34 dials), ulYmZptEHURHKNHQS8Rs (1 dials). Confirm whether they should be added to the roster.
783 contacts are stuck carrying the sid-dial-1 toggle tag, which means dial pairs are not completing and attempt counts are not incrementing correctly. Check WF-2 before trusting attempt numbers.
